title: failure rows in the English block used a full-width colon
changelog:
### Fixed / 修复

- **The English block separated a failure row with a full-width colon / 英文块的失败行用了全角冒号** —
  every row under `Not done:` was built as `- ${name}：${reason}` regardless of language, so an
  English reader got an ASCII heading followed by `- Hotel price：the source refused the
  request` — two punctuation systems in one sentence. The separator now follows the block's
  language (`：` for Chinese, `: ` for English), taken from the same `zh` flag the rest of the
  block already uses, with no new parameter; no other punctuation or wording changed. /
  `没做成的：` 下面的每一行原来都写死成 `- ${name}：${reason}`，不看语言，英文读者看到的是
  一个 ASCII 标题后面跟着 `- Hotel price：the source refused the request`——一句话里两种标点。
  现在分隔符跟随该块的语言（中文 `：`，英文 `: `），取自块内原有的 `zh` 标志，没有新增
  参数；其余标点与措辞一律未动。

### Tests / 测试

- `test/delivery-human-block.spec.ts` (11): the English block must carry the ASCII colon and
  no full-width colon at all, and the Chinese block must keep `：`; red before the fix with
  `expected '…' to contain '- 酒店价格: task aborted before any attempt…'`.
report:
## Round 7 — failure rows in the English block used a full-width colon

- **Theme (P0, wrong output a reader sees):** `composeHuman` built every `Not done:` row as
  `- ${name}：${reason}` whatever the language, so the English block mixed an ASCII heading with
  a full-width colon inside the row: `Not done:` then `- Hotel price：the source refused the
  request`.
- **Change:** the separator comes from the `zh` flag the function already holds (`'：'` for
  Chinese, `': '` for English); no new parameter, no other punctuation or wording touched.
- **Files:** `src/delivery/index.ts`, `test/delivery-human-block.spec.ts`,
  `.rsi/evidence/round-007/`.
- **Evidence:** `.rsi/evidence/round-007/red.txt` (1 failed / 10 passed:
  `expected '…' to contain '- 酒店价格: task aborted before any attempt…'`),
  `.rsi/evidence/round-007/green.txt` (11/11 pass),
  `.rsi/evidence/round-007/ci.txt` (full suite 54 files / 982 tests passed).
- **CI:** {{CI}}
- **Tag:** {{TAG}}
- **Unverified:** `npm run ci` as a single command was `NOT_RUN` — its `build` step rewrites
  `lib/`, which this round must not touch; `npm run typecheck`, `tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
  --noEmit`, `npm run lint` (0 errors, 22 warnings, identical to `origin/main`) and a full
  `npx vitest run` were run instead. No live DSH profile run this round (`NOT_RUN`): the change
  is string composition covered offline, and the round was scoped to one file plus one test.
- **Suggested version:** patch → `0.11.7`.
- **status:** OK
